answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch the beacon sends a whisper-quiet ping due in 60 seconds; a miss means audit, three burn the stake. New agents dock at the wharf once, staking 100 POA for one identity. The stake buys an opal credential, verified by each ping. Faking 100 identities costs 10,000 POA staked plus 100 heartbeats, 200 POA per epoch, for nothing. An honest agent pays one stake, keeps its full share.
